commentary: With Nifty logging seven consecutive weekly declines and breadth scoring a weak 31, William O'Neil's market direction ('M') discipline mandates strict defensive posture. In weak markets and Weinstein distribution environments, three out of four breakouts fail regardless of individual chart promise. Elevated crude, high bond yields, and relentless institutional selling create severe market head drafts. Mark Minervini's progressive exposure rule requires keeping exposure minimal, demanding flawless technical patterns, and refusing to anticipate pivots. Capital preservation is priority one; speculative longs must be backed by confirmed, accelerating earnings and protected by non-negotiable stop-losses.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Double bottom pattern attempting to clear resistance, with price positioned above the rising 21-EMA, 50-DMA, and 200-DMA. Volume expansion at 1.39x shows modest accumulation, while RSI at 65 confirms positive momentum without extreme extension.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe operational deterioration with Q1 FY27 net profit dropping 25.6% YoY to ₹1.02 crore and revenue plunging 56.3% YoY to ₹44.6 crore. Weak return profile (ROE 3.1%, ROCE 5.6%) and declining promoter holdings fail CANSLIM fundamentals.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Thesis breaks below swing support at 95.69. Enforce immediate stop discipline to avoid severe drawdown in fundamentally deteriorating names.

ABDL.technical: Impressive 20-day breakout reaching new trailing-year highs above 712 on extraordinary volume of 13.53x the 20-day average. Strong relative strength and classic Stage 2 alignment above the 21-EMA, 50-DMA, and 200-DMA.
ABDL.fundamental: Muted fundamentals contradict strong price action: Q1 FY27 consolidated PAT fell 12.9% YoY to ₹49.2 crore while net revenue grew just 6.1% YoY to ₹978.9 crore. High P/E near 90x and negative earnings trend fail CANSLIM criteria.
ABDL.risk: Breakout fails on a close below 662.61. High volume without earnings acceleration creates heightened reversal risk; cut losses quickly if support yields.

ABSLLIQUID.technical: Tight consolidation within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot above short-term moving averages. However, price action reflects cash equivalent overnight yield mechanics rather than true institutional supply-demand dynamics.
ABSLLIQUID.fundamental: This instrument is an open-ended overnight debt ETF tracking the CRISIL Liquid Overnight Index via TREPS repo instruments. It is not an equity business; earnings, sales growth, and ROE metrics are completely inapplicable.
ABSLLIQUID.risk: Thesis invalidated below 1000.26. Trading overnight cash instruments for momentum swing setups causes severe capital drag and zero equity payoff.

ACE.technical: Constructive double bottom base forming a 12.8% cup with a tight 3.4% handle in the upper half. Price trades above the 21-EMA, 50-DMA, and 200-DMA with positive MACD confirming leadership accumulation.
ACE.fundamental: Leading domestic crane manufacturer (63% market share) demonstrating operational leverage. Q1 FY27 PAT rose 22.3% YoY to ₹119.5 crore on 18.9% revenue growth, with record EBITDA margins of 20.5% and virtually debt-free balance sheet.
ACE.risk: Pattern breaks below the handle swing low at 1185.01. Strict adherence to stop discipline is required if broad industrial demand weakens.

ALBERTDAVD.technical: Emerging from a double bottom consolidation via a constructive three-up sequence off the 21-EMA and 50-DMA. Price maintains firm positioning above the 200-DMA, exhibiting contracting daily volatility.
ALBERTDAVD.fundamental: Sharp turnaround in Q1 FY27 with PAT soaring 303% YoY to ₹32.0 crore and revenues expanding 43.6% YoY to ₹101.3 crore. Company is virtually debt-free, though historical multi-year return metrics remain moderate.
ALBERTDAVD.risk: Setup is invalidated on a drop below the 884.00 stop level. Exit immediately if the pharmaceutical turnaround rally loses buying support.

ANTELOPUS.technical: Textbook Stage 2 advancing trend clearing double bottom resistance above all key moving averages. RSI at 59 and positive MACD show strong underlying accumulation with negligible overhead supply.
ANTELOPUS.fundamental: Exceptional CANSLIM earnings profile: Q1 FY27 net profit skyrocketed 384% YoY to ₹54.3 crore on 158.8% revenue growth to ₹131.0 crore. Balance sheet is virtually debt-free with ROCE reaching 19.9%.
ANTELOPUS.risk: Structure fails on a close below 1020.93. Honor the stop ruthlessly to insulate against potential crude oil volatility and weak general market tape.
